title: Pokémon Crystal Version
shortDescription: A role-playing journey through Johto and Kanto that adds a stronger sense of time, version identity, and collection to the classic formula.
highlights: A broad creature-collection loop supports long-term planning and discovery
Johto and Kanto create a satisfying sense of continuity between regions

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
